records.name: Maiden Burst
records.effect: Creates a heart-shaped energy barrier/explosion around the user.

records.name: Fake Blast
records.effect: Teleports behind the opponent and releases a damaging burst that can inflict paralysis.

records.name: Energy Dome
records.effect: Creates a dome-shaped Ki barrier around the user that can nullify incoming Ki attacks.

records.name: Super Explosive Wave
records.effect: Generates a large defensive explosion that launches nearby opponents.

notes: These are documented as Ki Blast Evasives. Shop/instructor acquisition is treated as not requiring an Ultimate Finish. Maiden Burst is retained as character-only because the current documentation does not identify Future Warrior access. External web search was attempted but the primary Fandom domain blocked automated retrieval; repository research proceeded from the established source URLs and existing project methodology rather than inventing unsupported fields.
